about.title: About Ngọc Ngân Bến Tre
about.description: Ngọc Ngân Bến Tre sources Cai Mon seedlings from trusted growers in Cho Lach, a region with a long tradition of plant nurseries. From fruit trees like durian and guava to ornamentals, every plant is picked for health and true-to-variety stock, with planting and care advice so you can grow with confidence.

origin.title: From Cai Mon – Cho Lach
origin.description: Sourced directly from trusted nurseries in Ben Tre's best-known seedling region.

grafted.title: Grafted, true to variety
grafted.description: Mostly grafted stock that keeps the parent tree's fruit and bearing time.

shipping.title: Careful packing, nationwide delivery
shipping.description: Root balls wrapped tight and boxed with airflow, shipped to every province.

cod.title: Cash on delivery
cod.description: You only pay when your plants arrive. No prepayment needed.
